lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg2Ti12O24 (MgTi6O12) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 38 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Mg centers as octahedral, coordinated by six O neighbors, while Ti centers adopt octahedral and six-vertex environments; one O orbit also shows a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors. Polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Mg and Ti octahedra, and edge-sharing among Ti octahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
